content.title: Right-of-Way Permit
content.summary: A Right-of-Way Permit is required for any land disturbing activities within public rights-of-way in the City of Woodinville, including trenching, boring, potholing, landscaping, and driveway modifications. Applications must include a completed form, related plans, and a traffic control plan.

steps.title: Prepare Application
steps.text: Complete the Right-of-Way Permit application form and prepare related plans, including a traffic control plan.

steps.title: Submit Application
steps.text: Submit the complete permit application, including required plans, supporting documents, and fees, through the City's online Permit Portal.

required_documents.name: Right-of-Way Permit Application Form
required_documents.description: Completed application form for the Right-of-Way Permit.

required_documents.name: Traffic Control Plan
required_documents.description: Plan detailing traffic control measures during the work in the right-of-way.
